                for w in range(3, min(max_w+1, len(grid[r1])-c1+1)):
                    c2 = c1 + w - 1
                    
                    top = grid[r1][c1:c2+1]
                    bot = grid[r2][c1:c2+1]
                    left = [grid[rr][c1] for rr in range(r1, r2+1)]
                    right = [grid[rr][c2] for rr in range(r1, r2+1)]
                    
                    ok = (all(v == bv for v in top) and
                         all(v == bv for v in bot) and
                         all(v == bv for v in left) and
                         all(v == bv for v in right))
                    
                    if not ok: continue
                    
                    ih, iw = h-2, w-2
                    
                    if ih < 1 or iw < 1: continue
                    
                    bg_count = 0
                    non_bg_set = set()
                    
                    for rr in range(r1+1, r2):
